label: About
title: About The Weight of a Curl
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1344 recent saved-signal files and 880 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @studio_brasch: Yohaku N°58 and Color Intersection M-II | The Art Institute of Chicago, plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Weight of a Curl: Portrait botanical abstraction on a softly tinted field. Two lateral ribbon-and-stem groups leave a broad clear gap. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Combed blue-lavender inner curl, Mint-and-lime hooked ribbon face, and Ragged cyan-and-pink strata at the upper blue edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
